description: Returns all-in EUR prices and inclusions for two delivery options between postal addresses in Spain (sender and recipient): a Correos burofax with acuse de recibo and copia certificada, and a certified notification by Notificados, a trusted third party distinct from Correos. Pricing uses the supplied page count, a character-count estimate, or one page by default. No draft, reservation or delivery is created.

option.description: Option the user asked about, if any. Both options are always returned.

pages.description: Number of A4 pages, 1–10, if already known.

text_length.description: Length of the letter body in characters, to estimate pages when the page count is unknown.
